causal_hypothesis: If two or three adjacent c32 decode ticks expose independent layer-consistent rows before the oldest tick completes, a semantics-preserving scheduler could issue M64 or M96 FP8 linears once per layer and amortize repeated FP8 weight reads and launches.

expected_direction.oldest_row_queue_delay: increase by one or two stock decode tick intervals before execution

stock_control: Pinned SGLang v0.5.13 non-spec c32 scheduler executes one token per active request per decode tick; the current qualified NGRAM control is analyzed separately and must not inherit the non-spec M32 geometry.
candidate_change: Hold compatible decode rows across two or three scheduler ticks and concatenate them only if source and trace evidence proves all rows are independently available with unchanged request, token, position, and KV ownership.

identities.hardware_scope: NVIDIA H200 SXM analytical inventory only
identities.workload: 32 simultaneous requests, 4214 prompt tokens and 358 completion tokens per request

workload_geometry.non_spec_decode: M32 exact consumer audit plus source-derived one-token ticks
workload_geometry.qualified_ngram: 32 requests, 12 target-verification rows per active request, exact event reconstruction

gates.mechanism: At least 64 independent compatible rows must be available at one layer before completing the oldest source tick; merely increasing resident concurrency or using already-present speculative rows does not pass.
gates.performance: Report completed-token service time, launch count, target weight bytes, queue delay, and whole-request upper bound; batch size alone is insufficient.

timeout.turn_deadline: bounded by the 100-minute project wall-clock contract
